FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
TechConnect Mobile Solutions operates as a retail and service provider specializing in the sales and repair of cellular phones and related accessories. Our core operations include offering a diverse selection of new and certified refurbished mobile devices, alongside a full range of accessories like cases, screen protectors, and chargers sourced from reputable manufacturers. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service through in-store consultations, device setup assistance, and technical support.

Our repair services encompass screen replacements, battery changes, software troubleshooting, and other repair solutions performed by trained technicians. We ensure that repairs are completed using high-quality parts, and we communicate clear, written warranties to our customers to mitigate any potential disputes.

Additionally, we employ robust inventory management practices to monitor stock levels and prevent loss through theft or damage. All employees undergo background checks, particularly those involved in handling high-value inventory. We are committed to following regulations to safeguard customer information during transactions, including secure payment processing. With regular audits and compliance checks, TechConnect Mobile Solutions maintains industry standards to promote a safe and reliable shopping experience for our community.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: TechConnect Accessories LLC, 4567 Gadget Lane, Tech City, CA 90210-5678 - A retail business specializing in electronic accessories, including phone cases, chargers, and audio equipment.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 04/15/2023, a theft incident occurred during which three high-value smartphones valued at $900 were stolen from our inventory due to an employee oversight in securing stock. The loss is currently under review for potential insurance coverage, and we are implementing additional security measures to prevent future occurrences.
